protocol.fallback: 8B only; one same-payload format retry with seed+1; 30B disabled.
protocol.rate_limit: Global 3s dispatch spacing and one worker; shared exponential cooldown on429; resume same request, pause on persistence.
protocol.runtime: Official pure functions/prompts with local JPEG crops and metered OpenRouter adapter.
deviations: Public crop-only configuration; paper may include additional tools.
Hosted providers and explicit seed/temperature; paper hosting may differ.
All inference uses hosted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on Parasail BF16; no 30B inference.
Invalid final/probe outputs get one same-model same-prompt format retry; original attempts retained.
Planner stop accepts natural language; MCQ validation occurs only at Direct/final reader.
Greedy minimum-size failures are returned as tool errors for re-proposal, matching the official executor.
One tool call per planner response enforced, matching the official prompt and avoiding invalid multi-tool message ordering.
Local data URLs replace S3/MinIO/MCP hosting; crop arithmetic and JPEG quality preserved.
Nonempty Direct/final analyses are model outcomes: absent MCQ choices are NO_ANSWER and score zero; paid original responses are retained via explicit overlays.
